She was named after her paternal grandmother , Marie Adelaide , Dauphine of France . As the daughter of the king , she was a fille de France . She was referred to as Madame Adélaïde from 1737 to 1755 and from 1759 to her death , and simply as Madame from 1755 to 1759 .
